brief:
While parts of Europe and the North Atlantic prepare to witness a total solar eclipse on August 12, 2026, Palestinians will not see the same phenomenon, Shehab Wire reported. Palestine lies outside the path where the moon will block the sun's disk during the event, leaving residents unable to observe the celestial occurrence.

The total solar eclipse will be visible across select regions of Europe and the North Atlantic, creating favorable viewing conditions for those in the eclipse's trajectory. For Palestinians and other populations outside this path, the eclipse will either not occur or will appear as only a partial solar eclipse. Total solar eclipses remain rare events for any given geographic location, occurring infrequently across the same territory over extended periods.
title: Palestinians will miss total solar eclipse crossing Europe in August 2026
